name: @bitwarden/cli
description: A secure and free password manager for all of your devices.
author: Bitwarden Inc. <hello@bitwarden.com> (https://bitwarden.com)

scripts.publish:npm: npm run build:oss:prod && npm publish --access public
scripts.dist:oss:win: npm run build:oss:prod && npm run clean && npm run package:oss:win
scripts.dist:oss:mac: npm run build:oss:prod && npm run clean && npm run package:oss:mac
scripts.dist:oss:mac-arm64: npm run build:oss:prod && npm run clean && npm run package:oss:mac-arm64
scripts.dist:oss:lin: npm run build:oss:prod && npm run clean && npm run package:oss:lin
scripts.dist:oss:lin-arm64: npm run build:oss:prod && npm run clean && npm run package:oss:lin-arm64
scripts.package:akb:mac-arm64: pkg build-akb/akb.js --config package.agentkeybox.json --targets node22-macos-arm64 --output dist/agentkeybox/macos-arm64/akb && node scripts/agentkeybox-release.mjs
scripts.dist:akb:mac-arm64: npm run build:akb && npm run package:akb:mac-arm64
scripts.package:akb:win-x64: pkg build-akb/akb.js --config package.agentkeybox.json --targets node22-win-x64 --no-bytecode --public --public-packages "*" --output dist/agentkeybox/windows-x64/akb.exe && node scripts/agentkeybox-release.mjs windows-x64
scripts.dist:akb:win-x64: npm run build:akb:win-x64 && npm run package:akb:win-x64
